model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates four lines representing data related to “AlphaEdit Efficacytop”, “AlphaEdit noiseε”, “DeltaEdit Efficacytop”, and “DeltaEdit noiseε” across a range of values. The x-axis is labeled “GPT2-XL”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 3000, and has tick labels at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled “Efficacytop” on the left and “noiseε” on the right, has a linear scale, ranges from 84 to 100 for the left axis and from 2 to 12 for the right axis. The line representing “AlphaEdit Efficacytop” is red, uses a circular marker, and a solid line style; it begins at approximately 98.2 at x=0 and declines to 88.0 at x=3000. The line representing “AlphaEdit noiseε” is red, uses a square marker, and a dashed line style; it begins at approximately 11.5 at x=0 and increases to 1.8 at x=3000. The line representing “DeltaEdit Efficacytop” is purple, uses a circular marker, and a dashed line style; it begins at approximately 87.5 at x=0 and increases to 95.0 at x=3000. The line representing “DeltaEdit noiseε” is purple, uses a square marker, and a solid line style, beginning at approximately 6.8 at x=0 and increasing to 11.8 at x=3000.
model_annotations.German:
The plot illustrates the relationship between efficacy and noise for AlphaEdit and DeltaEdit models, with both shown across a range of parameter values. The x-axis is labeled “GPT2-XL” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3000, with tick labels at intervals of 500. The left y-axis is labeled “Efficacytop” and has a linear scale ranging from 84 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The right y-axis is labeled “noiseε” and has a linear scale ranging from 2 to 12, with tick labels at intervals of 2. 

The line representing AlphaEdit Efficacytop is dashed, red, and lacks markers; it starts at approximately 87.5 when the x-value is 0 and declines to approximately 85.5 when the x-value is 3000. The line representing DeltaEdit Efficacytop is dashed, purple, and lacks markers, beginning at approximately 87.5 when the x-value is 0 and decreasing steadily to approximately 93 when the x-value is 3000.

The line representing AlphaEdit noiseε is solid, red, and includes circular markers; it begins at approximately 8.5 when the x-value is 0, and increases to approximately 11.5 when the x-value is 3000. The line representing DeltaEdit noiseε is solid, blue, and includes circular markers; it begins at approximately 8.5 when the x-value is 0, and increases to approximately 10 when the x-value is 3000.
